brief:
A majority of University of Michigan faculty voted in support of pro-Palestine students and staff who face federal criminal charges, the Middle East Eye reported. The charges stem from activism related to the 2024 Gaza conflict. The vote reflects faculty backing for the dozen former students and staff members currently prosecuted.

The timing and specific charges were not detailed in available reporting.

title: University of Michigan faculty backs pro-Palestine students facing federal charges
